name: Bronwen
text: Bronwen is a Welsh personal name. Some writers treat it as a variant of Branwen. The name joins the Welsh words bran, breast, and gwen, fair. It can mean white-bosomed one. Scholars link the figure to the Arthurian ladies Brangwaine and Brangoene. Proinsias Mac Cana wrote Branwen, Daughter of Llyr. Rachel Bromwich treated her in Trioedd Ynys Prydain.
